product_one_liner.value: Qubrid AI provides GPU infrastructure and unified API access to AI models for developers, researchers and enterprises building and deploying AI workloads in the cloud or on-premises.

named_customers.notes: Both appear in the homepage's customer/user logo section.

employee_band.notes: Based on the reported count of 16 employees as of January 29, 2026.

eng_blog.notes: The inspected index lists model pricing, benchmarks and API guides, rather than at least two engineer-authored posts explaining how Qubrid itself is built.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation covers getting started, AI Model Studio, AI Compute Platform and platform updates.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Full Stack AI Engineer is listed on the official careers board with a readable application page.

model_provider.notes: The product explicitly advertises unified API access to these model families.

compliance_certs.notes: Specifically claims its GPU infrastructure is deployed in SOC 2- and HIPAA-compliant data centers; this does not establish separate company-level certification.

last_funding.notes: Latest completed round listed: June 14, 2024; amount undisclosed. The $25 million seed round is marked upcoming and is excluded.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest completed round listed is June 14, 2024, before the May 9, 2025 cutoff; the later seed round is marked upcoming.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The official board lists GPU Kubernetes Cluster Engineer and Full Stack AI Engineer, with no qualifying sales-representative or account-executive title.

launched_6mo.notes: Launched Model Comparison on June 11, 2026, enabling side-by-side evaluation of serverless models.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No verifiable in-window appointment or departure, or complete leadership roster with start dates, was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A Qubrid job description says to maintain and update CRM (HubSpot/Zoho); it does not distinguish which system is deployed.
